title.en: An Act Creating the Northern Engineering District in the Province of Batangas
title.orig: An Act Creating the Northern Engineering District in the Province of Batangas

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1968/ra_5350_1968.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Any provision of law to the contrary notwithstanding, the Third Congressional District of the Province of Batangas, except the City of Lipa, is hereby constituted into a separate engineering district to be known as the Northern Engineering District of the Province of Batangas, with principal offices at the Municipality of Tanauan, same province.

The Secretary of Public Works and Communications shall allocate the necessary personnel, property, equipment, materials and supplies to the new engineering district within the period of ninety days after the approval of this Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 15, 1968.
